command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; git fetch origin --prune; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'verify_duplicate_dirty.py'; @'

import hashlib, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

root=Path(r"C:\dev\flyExplorer")
def run(*args,check=True,text=False):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=root,check=check,capture_output=True,text=text)

head=run("git","rev-parse","HEAD",text=True).stdout.strip()
origin=run("git","rev-parse","origin/main",text=True).stdout.strip()
print("LOCAL_HEAD",head,flush=True)
print("ORIGIN_MAIN",origin,flush=True)
anc=subprocess.run(["git","merge-base","--is-ancestor",head,origin],cwd=root)
if anc.returncode!=0:
    raise RuntimeError("Local HEAD is not an ancestor of origin/main")

status=run("git","status","--porcelain=v1","-z").stdout
entries=[x for x in status.split(b"\0") if x]
print("DIRTY_ENTRY_COUNT",len(entries),flush=True)
if not entries:
    print("DIRTY_ALREADY_CLEAN",flush=True)
    sys.exit(0)

paths=[]
for e in entries:
    # porcelain v1: XY<space>path. Rename is not expected; refuse ambiguity.
    if len(e)<4:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Malformed status entry: {e!r}")
    code=e[:2].decode("ascii","replace")
    path=e[3:].decode("utf-8","surrogateescape")
    if "R" in code or "C" in code:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Refusing rename/copy dirty entry: {code} {path}")
    paths.append((code,path))

for code,path in paths:
    local=(root/path).read_bytes()
    p=subprocess.run(["git","show",f"origin/main:{path}"],cwd=root,capture_output=True)
    if p.returncode!=0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Dirty path is not present in origin/main: {code} {path}")
    lhash=hashlib.sha256(local).hexdigest()
    rhash=hashlib.sha256(p.stdout).hexdigest()
    same=lhash==rhash
    print("DIRTY_COMPARE",code,path,"IDENTICAL",same,"SHA256",lhash,flush=True)
    if not same:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Dirty path differs from origin/main: {path}")
print("ALL_DIRTY_PATHS_IDENTICAL_TO_ORIGIN_MAIN",True,flush=True)

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding utf8; python -X utf8 $script; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($rc -ne 0){exit $rc}; $dirty=@(git status --porcelain); if($dirty.Count -gt 0){ git stash push -u -m 'superseded Known Folder work already in main'; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE} }; git merge --ff-only origin/main; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; $after=@(git status --porcelain); if($after.Count -ne 0){$after|ForEach-Object{Write-Output $_}; throw 'Checkout not clean after fast-forward.'}; $head=git rev-parse HEAD; $origin=git rev-parse origin/main; Write-Output "SYNCED_HEAD=$head"; Write-Output "SYNCED_ORIGIN=$origin"; if($head -ne $origin){throw 'HEAD != origin/main after fast-forward'}; $stashTop=git stash list -1; if($stashTop -like '*superseded Known Folder work already in main*'){ git stash drop 'stash@{0}'; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; Write-Output 'DUPLICATE_STASH_DROPPED=True' }; Write-Output 'SYNCED_CLEAN=True'
